system.notes: By extolling the power and the glory of the Titanoi to their followers, Zoran sorcerers are able to strengthen their resolve by increasing their WIL score by +3. Typically this boon of the Titanoi is sought immediately before going into battle, steeling the nerves of the sorcerer themselves and two willing disciples, but it has also been used to harden the resolve of soldiers throwing themselves against Legionnaires.
